beats.text: May infant-formula samples, poster, at regalo para sa promosyon ang bisita. Sabi ni Mimi: Salamat. Hindi ko po tatanggapin o ipapaskil ang mga ito.
Milk Code ang batayan sa formula promotion. Prescription samples: bawal ang pamimigay sa publiko sa pharmaceutical order. Itugma ang dahilan; hindi nag-aapruba ang BHW.
Libre naman; iwan ko na lang, sabi ng bisita. Sagot ni Mimi: Hindi ko po tatanggapin o ipamimigay. Huwag po itong iwan. Walang lihim na kasunduan.
Ipinaalam ni Mimi ang produkto, alok, hinihinging gawain, at sariling pagtanggi sa namamahala. Lokal na proseso ang sundin; walang datos ng pasyente o haka-haka.
Tumanggap si Danilo dahil nahiyang tumanggi. Si Mimi ay magalang pero malinaw na hindi. Tugma ang kilos sa sinabi, walang pagtanggap o pangakong exception.
Magsanay: magpasalamat, malinaw na tumanggi, ipaliwanag ang tamang batayan, at mag-ulat. Ulitin ang hangganan nang mahinahon. Hiwalay ang praktikal na obserbasyon sa online completion.
A visitor offers infant-formula samples, a poster, and a gift for promotion. Mimi says: Thank you. I will not accept or display these items.

The Milk Code applies to formula promotion. Prescription samples have a different basis: the pharmaceutical order prohibits public distribution. Match the reason; the BHW does not approve independently.
It is free; I will leave it here, says the visitor. Mimi responds: I will not accept or distribute it. Please do not leave it. No secret agreement or alternative promotion.
Mimi tells the supervisor the product, offer, requested activity, and her refusal. Report facts through the local process, without patient data or guesses about motives.
Danilo accepts because he feels embarrassed to refuse. Mimi is respectful but clearly says no. Tone is insufficient if there is acceptance or a promised exception. Actions must match the words.
Practice: acknowledge, clearly decline, explain the correct basis, and report. Repeat the boundary calmly. Practical role-play is observed separately; online completion alone is insufficient.
